"For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life." (John 3:16)

Many people don’t experience God's presence because, in general, they ignore Him. That indifference separates us from God (Romans 3:23).

We constantly try to reach God and the abundant life through our own efforts—by living a good life, through philosophy, or religion... But do we truly succeed?

Jesus Christ stands up for us. God Himself sent Him so that we could come to know Him better and understand His love and plan for this world and for our lives!

Jesus says:
"Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me." (Revelation 3:20)

Do you want to open the door of your heart to Jesus?
Feel free to say that—out loud or in your heart. You don't need fancy words: God knows your heart and cares more about your attitude than your wording.

Here is a suggested prayer:
Lord Jesus, I need You. Thank You for dying on the cross for my sins. I want to welcome you in my life. Thank You for forgiving my sins and giving me eternal life. Take control of my life. Make me the kind of person You want me to be.

If this prayer reflects the desire of your heart, you can pray it now. Christ will come into your life according to His promise.

Receiving Christ involves turning to God from self (repentance) and trusting Christ to come into our lives to forgive our sins and to make us what He wants us to be. Just to agree intellectually that Jesus Christ is the Son of God and that He died on the cross for your sins is not enough. Nor is it enough to have an emotional experience. You receive Jesus Christ by faith, as an act of the will.

You can receive Christ right now by faith through prayer.

They started out as average, unexceptional men of their time: fishermen, farmers, local magistrates. But their dedication to a prophetic Jewish preacher in the backwaters of the Roman Empire transformed them into revolutionaries and, in the process, changed the world itself in ways that would reverberate across time for two thousand years.  Now, discover the extraordinary, untold stories of the men chosen by Jesus to bring God's plan to the world. Among them are Peter, who denied Christ three times but later became a "Rock," James and John, the fiery tempered "sons of thunder," Matthew, the tax collector later murdered by cannibals, Simon the Zealot, the anti-Roman fanatic eventually "cut to pieces" preaching in Spain, and Judas Iscariot, whose betrayal would be paid for with silver and suicide. From their early fear and discouragement at the shock of the Crucifixion, to the final acceptance of the resurrection and their epic mission to spread the Gospel through the known world, it's an inspiring, astonishing story of the little-known men who became The Twelve Apostles.

In December 2022, a film crew from Saint Photios Orthodox Theological Seminary was sent to the cold and snowy land of Western Canada to film a documentary about the Protection of the Holy Virgin Mary Convent. After much anticipation, the full-length documentary has finally been released!

This documentary follows the everyday life of the nuns living at the Protection of the Holy Virgin Mary Convent, discusses the history and founding of the community by the ever-memorable Archbishop Ioasaph of Buenos Aires (1888–1955), and explores how the nuns have impacted the people around them.

In 1993, the current Superior, the Very Reverend Abbess Mother Amvrosia Hagiaskepitissa, came to what was left of a small monastic property in the hamlet of Bluffton, Alberta. Alone with her mother, who was also a nun, Mother Amvrosia struggled to rebuild the property, which was in incredibly poor condition. However, over time, new novices came to the Convent and made it what it is today—a gem in the North.

Words cannot express how grateful we are for all those who came together to help make this documentary a reality. All the challenges that came about during the making of the film could not have been overcome without their help! 

We also want to thank all the supporters of the Seminary who make it possible for us to bring you Orthodox Christian content just like this! Your support is so greatly appreciated.

Without further ado, please enjoy watching the story of The Little Convent.

Although the Old Calendar Orthodox Church of Bulgaria finally obtained legal registration after many years of efforts, recent legislative changes supported by the Patriarchate of Bulgaria have once again placed its future in jeopardy. From Friends of Mount Sinai Monastery  - In support of St. Catherine's Monastery in Sinai (http://www.mountsinaimonastery.org/#intro) (https://www.facebook.com/Friends-of-Mount-Sinai-Monastery-909870469077630/)

We present a recent documentary with English subtitles about St. Paisios of Mount Athos, a newly glorified saint, at St. Catherine Monastery in Sinai.

The film "Paisios of the Holy Mountain" was made by a Russian author/director Alexander Kouprin under the guidance of Igumen Cyprian (Yaschenko) of the Holy Trinity - St. Sergius Lavra near Moscow, and on the advice of Elder Euthymius of Mount Athos. It features unique scenes of the monastery, the cell of Ss. Galaktion and Epistimi and other majestic Sinai sites. 

Archbishop Damianos of Sinai, Pharan and Raitho, Abbot of St. Catherine’s Monastery, Elder Pavlos and others talk about their memories of St. Paisios in Sinai. The film consists of six parts and is based on the Life Account of Elder Paisios by Hieromonk Isaac and other sources.

It is a very special way to gain insight into the St. Catherine Monastery's monastic life and history, as well as desert experiences on Mt. Sinai, through the eyes and words of Elder Paisios - one of the most loved saints of the 20th century.

tk25sDQMqHc.title: A Fountain of Holiness: The life of Saint John of Rila!
tk25sDQMqHc.author: Trisagion Films
tk25sDQMqHc.desc:
Saint John of Rila, the first wonderworker and hermit of Bulgaria, was born around 876 in Skrino, modern-day Bulgaria. He was blessed with deeply devout Christian parents whose devotion to God served as a guiding light for the Saint. From his earliest years, he was captivated by a strong love for Christ that he would spend the rest of his life serving and worshipping God, leaving behind him a powerful lasting example of righteousness and holiness for centuries to come. 
From early childhood, Saint John showed an extraordinary love for God and a remarkable purity of spirit. While his peers spent their time playing, he found peace and joy in the local Church, where he stood very still, listening intently to the holy services' mysterious and sacred words and chants. His heart was drawn to prayer and solitude, and he often wandered alone into the wilderness surrounding his village to pray and fast.

Saint Spyridon of Trimythus the Wonderworker was born to a Christian family of shepherds on the Island of Cyprus around the year 270 AD in the village of Askia during the reign of Emperor Aurelian, a persecutor of Christians. Spyridon grew up herding sheep and continued to do so for the rest of his life. When he came of age, he was married and had children.

Because he showed them love when no one else would, because he radiated holiness, because through his humility God dwelt within him, and he made signs and wonders to the people of that remote yet important place.

Indeed, his life and noble works have left an everlasting imprint on the region, beckoning pilgrims from across the globe to journey to Spruce Island and venerate his holy tomb seeking his intercessions.

vkYBFoX2Wc4.desc:
Not many women from the pagan Roman period are remembered for their greatness. A woman, during that time, did not have the opportunities for education or social advancement as did men. But once in a while, a really gifted woman would rise up, would stun the masses not only with her beauty, but also with her education and wisdom. Such was Katherine, the Great Martyr, still remembered today as an amazing Christian woman. The early Christians, by recounting her life, presented not only the value of a woman as a saint, but also sought to correct and convert the pagans of their time.
St. Catherine is one of those women of antiquity who stood out in Roman society at the end of the 3rd and beginning of the 4th centuries. 
The early Christians, by recounting her life, presented and emphasized the value of the woman, who is also made in the image of God, but, at the same time, sought to correct the many errors of the pagans and convert them to the Christian Faith.

LD4PkExm31g.title: Μοναστήρια της Κύπρου: «Ι.Μ. Κύκκου» και «Ι.Μ. Αγίου Νεοφύτου» | Φωτεινά Μονοπάτια
LD4PkExm31g.author: ΕΡΤ Α.Ε.
LD4PkExm31g.desc:
Τα μοναστήρια της Κύπρου: «Ιερά Μονή Κύκκου» και «Ιερά Μονή του Αγίου Νεοφύτου»

«Ιερά Μονή Κύκκου»
Μία από τις μεγαλύτερες και ιστορικότερες ιερές μονές της Κύπρου, είναι η Ιερά Μονή Κύκκου. Βρίσκεται στο δυτικό μέρος της οροσειράς του Τροόδους, σε υψόμετρο περίπου 1.300 μέτρων και ιδρύθηκε γύρω στα τέλη του 11ου αιώνα, από τον βυζαντινό αυτοκράτορα Αλέξιο Α΄ τον Κομνηνό.
Κέντρο αναφοράς της ιεράς μονής είναι η θαυματουργή εικόνα της Παναγίας της Ελεούσας (του Κύκκου), που παρουσιάζει την Παναγία Βρεφοκρατούσα, αγιογραφημένη κατά την παράδοση από τον Ευαγγελιστή Λουκά.
Βορειότερα της μονής, βρίσκεται «Το Θρονί της Παναγίας». Στο σημείο αυτό, παλαιότερα, υπήρχε ένας ξύλινος θρόνος, όπου τοποθετούσαν την Αγία Εικόνα και πραγματοποιούσαν δεήσεις προς τη Θεοτόκο.
Κατά τη λατινοκρατία, η μονή συντηρούσε και διαιώνιζε την παράδοση, την ελληνική γλώσσα και την ιστορική μνήμη, μέσα από εκκλησιαστικά κείμενα.
Το Μουσείο της Ιεράς Μονής Κύκκου, είναι ένα μοναδικό πολιτιστικό και ιστορικό ίδρυμα.
Η τεράστια συλλογή υπέροχων αρχαιοτήτων, έργων Τέχνης και θησαυρών, αποκαλύπτει την ιστορία της Κύπρου, αλλά και το μεγαλείο της ιστορίας της μονής.

«Ιερά Μονή του Αγίου Νεοφύτου»
Είναι κτισμένη στο μυχό μιας βαθιάς κοιλάδας, περίπου 10 χιλιόμετρα βορειοδυτικά της πόλης της Πάφου. Ιδρυτής της μονής είναι ο Άγιος Νεόφυτος. Ο ίδιος έζησε εκεί και πέθανε το 1219, σε ηλικία 85 ετών.
Η Εγκλείστρα είναι ο αρχικός πυρήνας της Μονής του Αγίου Νεοφύτου. Πρόκειται για έναν κλειστό χώρο, σκαλισμένο στο βράχο από τον αναχωρητή Άγιο, στο τέλος του 12ου αιώνα.
Είναι διακοσμημένη με περίφημες βυζαντινές νωπογραφίες, του 12ου έως και του 15ου αιώνα.
Η φήμη της αγιότητας του Νεοφύτου, έφτασε σε όλα τα μέρη της Κύπρου και η Εγκλείστρα έγινε προσκύνημα για πολλούς πιστούς.
Ο Άγιος Νεόφυτος ανέπτυξε έντονη συγγραφική δραστηριότητα, που τον ανέδειξε ως έναν από τους μεγαλύτερους συγγραφείς του μεσαιωνικού ελληνισμού της Κύπρου.

The Ten Commandments is a 1923 American silent epic film produced and directed by Cecil B. DeMille. Quo Vadis? is a 1912 film directed by Enrico Guazzoni, based on the 1896 novel of the same name. It was the first blockbuster in the history of cinema, with 5,000 extras, lavish sets, and a running time of two hours, setting the standard for "superspectacles" for decades to come.
A worldwide success, it was the first film to be projected in a first-class Broadway theater, where it was screened for nine months from April to December 1913. The film's first screening in London was for King George V, who complimented the performers. Two years later, in 1914, Pastrone directed Cabiria, which was similar to Quo Vadis?, but was even longer, more complex, and more spectacular.
The story is set during the early years of rule by the emperor Nero. He is an ambitious man obsessed with gaining absolute power. His soldier falls in love with a young Christian slave named Lycia, but their love is hindered by Nero, who hates Christianity and unleashes his officers to burn Rome, pinning the blame on the Christians. In addition, the cruel Nero kidnaps the pair and sends them into an arena to fight lions.

blood_of_jesus.desc: The Blood of Jesus (1941) is a classic example of the "race film" genre of films by African-American directors and casts, geared exclusively for an African-American audience. This film, written and directed by Spencer William Jr. of the TV show Amos & Andy Show (who also played Razz Williams in the film), is a morality tale about a woman (Cathryn Caviness) who is accidentally shot to death by her husband. Facing death, she must choose between Hell, represented as urban life, and Zion, represented as pastoral America, and between Satan and God. The climax comes when she makes her decision at the foot of the cross and wakes up to singing of her church choir. Intended to promote a Black Southern Baptist ideal of a virtuous rural life, the film was a major success and the most popular hit in its genre. See Also, IMDB Entry The film has also been selected for preservation in the United States National Film Registry. tr2.The Blood of Jesus ( 1941 ) is a classic: Gjaku i Jisuit ( 1941) është një shembull klasik i " filmit të garës " zhanri i filmave nga drejtorët dhe hedhësit afrikanë-amerikanë, i pajisur vetëm për një auditor afrikano-amerikan.
